near_miss_control.reading: Both denominators converge on the SAME fibre, SAME lambda, SAME selected set and the SAME float lead 1.001451519478135. non_claims: This is an exact rational counterexample, not a Lean proof. Evidence class is EXACT_RATIONAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE_INDEPENDENTLY_RECOMPUTED, not PROVED_FALSE.
It refutes D6-prime at m=6, |U|=3, corner reference. It says nothing about other m, other alphabets, or non-corner references.
why_this_audit_is_needed: The search script's rank_one_verified flag checks CENTRED contrast rank one. Under --fiber-kind raw the witness is raw rank one only by construction of the basis. This audit certifies raw local contrast rank one directly, as an exact rank over Q of the K x |Z| raw-contrast matrix at each coordinate, and recomputes the whole decision layer with an evaluator sharing no code with the search script.
